builds.hypothesis: Q5 each first-target shuriken240+bonusAD; Zed,W,R shadows supply three projectiles. AD/armor penetration strengthen them, no pass-through reduction if first victim. Bloodthirster supplies80AD. Hubris supplies AD plus exactly10 credited kills in its90s buff. Profane/Youmuu/Edge addAD/lethality, and Serylda is sole percent-armor-penetration-family item. Hydra active/cleave excluded. 30min Gathering Storm adaptive stats fixed; Absolute Focus requires ownerabove70%HP. First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

ceiling.finiteState: Benchmark game30min,level18,max target rank,no elixirs/dragons/unlisted allied buffs. Enemy3000maxHP,900currentHP,100armor,50MR,1500bonusHP before legal debuffs; record raw overkill separately. Both legal shadows active; all three trajectories hit victim first. Hubris exactly10 credited kills, buff active90s; unbounded kills/time have no finite global maximum.
